data.narrative:
Palantir is a Series E AI & Software company with a last post-money valuation of $312.5B and $3B+ raised to date. The comparable universe consists of one public peer (PLTR) and eight private companies in the same sector and stage, including Crusoe Energy, SandboxAQ, Ayar Labs, Waymo, and Figure AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.4x multiplier typical for Series E advancement, implies a valuation of $437.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, SandboxAQ at $5.8B, and Ayar Labs at $3.8B) yields a median implied valuation of $5.8B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $10.0B.

Triangulation across these two methods produces a low estimate of $4.9B, a median of $221.6B, and a high of $503.1B. The wide range reflects material divergence between stage-progression methodology—anchored to the $312.5B last post-money—and peer-median analysis, which suggests substantially lower valuations for same-stage AI & Software companies. Key uncertainties include whether Palantir's scale and profitability position it outside the peer median band, and whether the public comp (PLTR trading history) provides additional anchoring information not captured in this analysis.
